source_text: Τάχα εἰσί τινες τοιοῦτον λαβόντες χάρισμα ὥστε μὴ ἐπιθυμεῖν. πλὴν ὁ Χριστὸς ὡς ἰσχυροποιήσας τὴν ἀνθρώπων φύσιν καὶ τὰ ὑπὲρ νόμον ἐπιτάσσει ὡς νῦν ἐγχωροῦντα· εἰ γὰρ καὶ τοῖς πρὸ τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἀδύνατον ἦν τοῦτο, ἀλλὰ τοῖς πιστοῖς εὐκατόρθωτον τὸ τὰς ἐπιθυμίας ἐκκόπτειν.
pass_a_gloss: Perhaps there are some having-received such a gift so as not to desire. But Christ as having-strengthened the of humans nature also the beyond law he commands as now being-possible; for if even to those before Christ impossible this was, yet to the faithful easy-to-accomplish the the desires to cut-out.
pass_b_english: Perhaps some have received such a gift that they do not desire. But Christ, having strengthened human nature, also commands what is beyond the law as now possible. Even if this was impossible for those before Christ, for the faithful cutting out desires is easy to accomplish.

choices.why: Christ raises the command above Torah minimum.
